# PeptShop frontend presentation: integration context

This repository is a presentation module consumed by a private application. It is designed to let
frontend contributors build and review marketplace layouts without receiving backend access or
production records.

## Presentation surfaces

- Home, catalog, product, vendor, and evidence layouts
- Cart, checkout, payment-pending, order lookup, and order-status layouts
- Contact, policy, article, FAQ, and authentication layouts
- Illustrative private-workspace layouts for local design preview only

## Data rules

All bundled names, vendors, laboratories, ratings, prices, orders, certificates, dates, and metrics
are synthetic. They exist only to exercise component states and responsive layouts. They are not
authoritative marketplace data and must not be indexed or repeated as real facts.

## Private-host boundary

The private host reviews and pins a frontend revision before deployment. It may supply sanitized
view models and narrowly typed callbacks. The presentation repository does not receive:

- Database or authentication access
- Environment values or provider credentials
- Real customer, vendor, payment, inventory, or fulfillment records
- Private pricing algorithms, commercial terms, internal economics, or incentive structures
- Administrative, settlement, payout, or notification implementation

## Synthetic production QA

The README documents a protected production-hosted QA lane. The lane uses a separate, expiring
fake-order store and reserved example.test identities. It can exercise order creation and fixed
synthetic lifecycle transitions without invoking real payment, customer, inventory, email,
fulfillment, seller, staff, or administrative systems.

The QA access code must be shared privately and must never appear in a URL, commit, issue,
screenshot, or recording.
